title: NSA Utah data center code-named Bumblehive
summary: Matthew Pines tells of NSA Utah data center code-named Bumblehive, about c. 2005-2013 at Utah, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yes. And what was interesting, so Utah data center, it's now declassified this code name. What the NSA set up then the largest sort of single data center in Utah back in the 2005s, something like that. And the code name for it was Bumblehive.

plain: A researcher named Matthew Pines tells podcast host Jesse Michels that the National Security Agency, the US agency that intercepts communications, built what was then its largest single data centre in Utah, around the mid 2000s. He says its code name, now made public, was Bumblehive, a detail he brings up while talking about secrecy and hidden government programmes.
